data.title: BIP-110 Bitcoin branch stalls after two blocks as gap widens
data.description: Bitcoin’s BIP-110-enforcing branch stalled at block 961,633 on Sunday after producing only two blocks, while the non-enforcing chain advanced to 961,721, widening the gap to 88 blocks.According to the BIP-110 monitor, updated at 10:19 am UTC, the branch’s latest block had been mined about 12 hours…
